CS-1001.title: Files not syncing on Windows 11
CS-1001.description: Customer reported that files saved in the shared folder stopped syncing after the 4.2 update. The tray icon shows 'Waiting for connection' although the network is fine.

CS-1002.title: Duplicate charge on monthly invoice
CS-1002.description: Customer was charged twice for the September subscription. Two identical transactions appear on their card statement on Sept 1.
CS-1002.resolution: Confirmed a duplicate payment caused by a gateway retry on Sept 1. Refunded the second charge of $49.00; the customer will see it on their card within 5-7 business days.

CS-1003.title: Users locked out after password reset
CS-1003.description: After an admin-triggered password reset, 12 users in the Finance group cannot sign in and receive error AUTH-403.

CS-1004.title: Request to increase storage quota
CS-1004.description: Customer on the Team plan asks how to increase storage from 1 TB to 5 TB without changing plans.

CS-1005.title: Dashboard export to PDF is blank
CS-1005.description: Exporting any dashboard to PDF produces a blank page in Chrome. Export to PNG works correctly.

CS-1006.title: Cannot update tax ID on account
CS-1006.description: Customer gets a validation error when entering an EU VAT number in the billing settings page.

CS-1007.title: Configure SAML with Okta
CS-1007.description: Customer needs step-by-step guidance to configure SAML 2.0 single sign-on with Okta as the identity provider.
CS-1007.resolution: Sent the SAML 2.0 setup guide for Okta and joined a call to configure the ACS URL, Entity ID, and signing certificate. Customer confirmed SSO sign-in works for all users.

CS-1008.title: Scheduled report emails not delivered
CS-1008.description: Daily scheduled reports stopped arriving after Oct 10. No bounce messages were received and the schedule shows as active.
